customerJobs.title: Join and run live classes
customerJobs.note: Students need to enter a session quickly; teachers need to run it, share resources, and track participants.

customerJobs.title: Collaborate in study groups
customerJobs.note: Share resources and discuss within groups tied to a course, department, and faculty.

customerJobs.title: Assign, submit, and grade tasks
customerJobs.note: Teachers announce tasks and grade against several criteria; students submit and track their work.

customerJobs.title: Administer the academic hierarchy
customerJobs.note: Admins manage faculties, departments, courses, and users, and audit activity.

pains.title: Scattered tools
pains.note: Schedules, discussions, submissions, and notes live in disconnected applications.

pains.title: Hard-to-type session IDs
pains.note: Random identifiers are impractical to enter when joining an in-person class.

pains.title: No unified grading flow
pains.note: Multi-criteria grading and submissions are handled outside a single system.

pains.title: No central admin view
pains.note: Administrators lack one place to manage the hierarchy and audit cross-course activity.

gains.title: One workspace
gains.note: Sessions, groups, tasks, and todos reachable from a single app.

gains.title: Role-appropriate interfaces
gains.note: Each role sees only the dashboards and actions that apply to it.

gains.title: Fast session entry
gains.note: Students join a live class with a short numeric code.

gains.title: Administrative visibility
gains.note: Analytics and logs give admins an overview of activity.

productsAndServices.title: Live Class Sessions
productsAndServices.note: Numeric session counters, participant tracking, resource sharing, and playground links.

productsAndServices.title: Collaborative Groups
productsAndServices.note: Groups with course, department, and faculty metadata, shared resources, and discussions.

productsAndServices.title: Task & Rubric System
productsAndServices.note: Task announcements, submissions, multi-criteria grading rubrics, and todo tracking.

productsAndServices.title: Admin Control Panel
productsAndServices.note: 16 admin pages and 6 dialogs for CRUD, analytics charts, and activity logs.

painRelievers.title: Modular single app
painRelievers.note: Nine domain modules on one Quasar shell replace several disconnected tools.

painRelievers.title: Atomic session counter
painRelievers.note: A Firestore transaction on metadata/counters assigns short, readable session numbers.

painRelievers.title: Rubric workflow
painRelievers.note: Grading criteria, submissions, and results live together in the task module.

painRelievers.title: Central admin suite
painRelievers.note: Hierarchy management and audit logs sit in one admin module.

gainCreators.title: Role-based routing
gainCreators.note: A boot-plugin guard sends each role to its own dashboard and blocks unauthorized routes.

gainCreators.title: Real-time data layer
gainCreators.note: Firestore backs live session and shared-resource updates.

gainCreators.title: Visual analytics
gainCreators.note: ApexCharts and Chart.js show user activity distributions and task statistics.

gainCreators.title: Decoupled state
gainCreators.note: Pinia stores with separate action files keep components declarative and consistent.
